name: Tensor

requiredConfig.name: TENSOR_API_KEY
requiredConfig.description: Server-side Tensor API key used by the host-wired Tensor client for collection, listing, bid, and wallet reads. Redacted from errors and receipts.

requiredConfig.name: Tensor client factory
requiredConfig.description: Host must call setTensorClientFactory(buildTensorClient) at boot. Optional SDKs @tensor-oss/tensorswap-sdk and @tensor-oss/tcomp-sdk back legacy and compressed transaction builds.

Active Tensor bids for a collection (bidder, bidPriceSol, quantity, escrow).
Recent Tensor marketplace sales for a collection (signature, mint, priceSol, buyer/seller, marketplace).

writeCapabilities.prepares: A prepared action to buy a Tensor NFT at or below maxPriceSol. Stores listing snapshot and rebuilds the transaction at execute time.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: The user reviews mint, current price, max price cap, seller, marketplace, compressed flag, fee, and royalty facts before wallet signing.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A prepared action to list a Tensor NFT at priceSol. Validates wallet ownership at prepare and re-checks at execute.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: The user reviews mint, list price, expiry, royalty, and warning facts before wallet signing.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A prepared action to cancel a Tensor listing for a wallet-owned NFT. Requires listingId when multiple open listings exist.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: The user reviews listing id, current price, and seller facts before wallet signing.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A prepared action to place a Tensor item or collection bid. Enforces maxEscrowSol against existing margin balance plus delta at prepare and execute.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: The user reviews collection, mint (if any), bid price, quantity, current escrow, and total escrow facts before wallet signing.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A prepared action to cancel a Tensor bid by bidId. Requires bidId when multiple open bids exist for the wallet.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: The user reviews bid id, bid price, escrow, and collection facts before wallet signing.

writeCapabilities.prepares: A prepared action to sweep up to ten Tensor listings under maxTotalSol and maxPricePerItemSol caps. Stores exact items; execute refreshes each listing and blocks any item that is delisted, sold, or repriced.
writeCapabilities.userApproves: The user reviews exact items, per-item caps, total cap, fee, royalty, and compressed flag before wallet signing.

unsupportedRequests: Autonomous NFT trading or bots that buy/list/bid without wallet approval.
Unlimited bid escrows or delegated escrow authorities.
Wash-trading detection, rarity claims, or guaranteed-profit claims.
NFT-collateralized leverage, loans, or price-lock derivatives.
Operate Tensor on devnet, testnet, or localnet (mainnet-beta only).
Mix legacy and compressed NFTs in one sweep prepared action.
Sweep more than 10 items in one prepared action.
Buy when the current Tensor listing price exceeds the user-supplied maxPriceSol cap.
List an NFT the connected wallet does not currently own.
Cancel a Tensor listing or bid that the connected wallet does not own.
Bid when the required escrow plus existing margin balance exceeds maxEscrowSol.
Sign, submit, or claim ownership of the on-chain transaction (only the wallet signs).
actionPreparationNotes: Tensor is first-class. Every prepare reads the current listing or bid snapshot, validates caps and ownership, and stores exact item state. Every execute refreshes the listing or bid, re-validates caps, rebuilds the unsigned transaction via the host-wired TensorClient (legacy via tensorswap-sdk, compressed via tcomp-sdk), and routes through signAndBroadcast. Sweep transactions are rebuilt at execute; the prepared transactionBase64 is never reused.
riskNotes: Tensor listings and bids drift between prepare and execute. The adapter rebuilds transactions at execute, refuses changed price or seller, and homogenizes compressed/legacy items per sweep. Show floor, listing seller, compressed flag, royalty, fee, and escrow facts before approval. Tensor API access is gated and TENSOR_API_KEY must be redacted from receipts.
walletApprovalBoundary: Tensor writes create prepared actions. The agent reviews and prepares; the user's wallet signs and broadcasts separately.

requests.user: prepare buying this NFT on Tensor for no more than 1.2 SOL. Do not sign.
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Tensor buy review with mint, current price, max price cap, seller, compressed flag, fee, and royalty facts. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

requests.user: prepare listing this NFT on Tensor for 2 SOL
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Tensor list review with mint, price, expiry, royalty, and ownership facts. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

requests.user: prepare a Tensor collection bid capped at 5 SOL escrow
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Tensor collection bid review with collection, bid price, quantity, current escrow, and total escrow facts. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.

requests.user: prepare sweeping the three cheapest listed items under 0.3 SOL each
requests.agentResponse: Prepared a Tensor sweep review with the exact items, per-item cap, total cap, and compressed flag. Execution will refresh each listing before any signature. This prepares a wallet approval request; it does not sign.
